wrappers.purpose: Execution environment: rocker/r-ver:4.3.2 (digest-pinned); the seven README package pins built from CRAN Archive source; packages the authors left unspecified from the Posit Package Manager snapshot of 2024-04-03 (first online appearance); fonts for PNG rendering; extrafontdb made writable for the non-root run user. Copies nothing from the attempt directory and edits no R start-up file.
Lane entry point: runs run-analysis.R (console teed to wrapper-captures/analysis-console.txt), then compare-results.R in a separate R process only if the analysis exits 0.

Runs the pristine S2.R byte-identical: copies S1.xlsx into authors-run/, parses S2.R once (parse(file =), UTF-8), evaluates its top-level expressions in order in the global environment, prints visible values as Rscript would, routes warnings and messages to stdout, uses a cairo PNG device as the screen device for the authors' top-level plot prints, tolerates only the font_import() error on S2.R line 27 (declared; computes nothing used), and captures read-only snapshots (bigrams before line 633, the finished session, sessionInfo, package inventory). All wrapper state lives in local(), outside the global environment.

Separate comparison script: reads the run's captures, the authors' exported CSVs, the deposited S1/S3 workbooks, and the published-value transcriptions read-only; labelled R1 verification aids (read-only S1 lookups; documented ggplot2/quanteda functions); writes value-level CSVs and aid plots to comparison-out/. Never loads or edits the authors' code.

Host-side transcription aid: measures the segments of the published Fig. 2 bar chart (embedded 300 ppi image extracted from the paper PDF into scratch) and writes published-values/fig2-left.csv. Reads only the publisher's figure; runs no authors' code and computes nothing from the data. Not loaded by any run.

Host-side transcription aid: reads the box state and centre colour of every lower-triangle cell of the published Fig. 4 heatmap (embedded 300 ppi image) and writes published-values/fig4-cells.csv. Reads only the publisher's figure; runs no authors' code and computes nothing from the data. Not loaded by any run.

notes: All four deposit files were fetched by unauthenticated HTTPS from the Zenodo API for record 10801706 (version 2, the AP-12 version of record; version 1, 10.5281/zenodo.10623550, deliberately not used) on 2026-10-11, and each md5 matched the checksum Zenodo publishes (also held in corpus/evidence-packs/harvest-2026-10-04/herskind-riede-2024.json). Only S2.R is code; S1.xlsx is the analysis data, S3.xlsx the authors' precomputed reference tables (published-values source for T08), and README.txt the environment statement. The executed copy is the pristine local copy itself, run byte-identical; no authors' file was edited. published-values/*.csv are the executor's transcriptions of the paper's printed values (data, not code).
